convergence_limit: Fixed-mesh contraction does not prove cross-mesh convergence; the consistency criterion needs whole-sequence convergence, not arbitrary subsequences.
counterexample_limit: Inconsistency of a chosen bicombing does not disprove existence of a different consistent bicombing on that space.
original_scope: Arbitrary metric spaces admitting a conical bicombing; no completeness hypothesis.
proper_space_limit: Consistent straight geodesics and equal-length convexity are weaker than an unrestricted conical conclusion.
verification_limits: Exact finite checks do not establish any infinite-mesh convergence or full solution.
Independent AI audit is not peer review or formal certification.
Bounded literature checks cannot exclude unlocated later work.
Source PDFs and full corpus files are omitted; external-input provenance replay is NOT_RUN without separately supplied inputs.
